items.title: Southwest & United Won’t Accept New Boeing 737 MAX Jets With Affected Software
items.summary: Southwest Airlines and United Airlines have told Boeing they will not accept new 737 MAX aircraft equipped with a recently identified flight-management-computer software issue, according to CNBC. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is currently reviewing the problem, which can cause automated vertical navigation to disengage during a specific missed-approach scenario.

items.title: Ten Years on from CORSIA Agreement, Governments Must Strengthen the Global Framework for Aviation Emissions
items.summary: IATA marked the tenth anniversary of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) assembly resolution to establish the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA) with a call to governments to reinforce the foundations of this landmark step in aviation's decarbonization.

9架次共機下午起配合共艦戰備警巡 國軍嚴密監控
items.summary: （中央社記者游凱翔台北6日電）國防部今天表示，自下午2時54分起，9架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線，進入台灣北部及中部空域，配合共艦，假所謂「聯合戰備警巡」之名，騷擾台灣周邊空、海域，國軍運用聯合情監偵手段嚴密掌握。
